narratives.Overview:
1. **Fail-closed cancel refuse (primary A).** On `scope:cancel`, before the move/stamp: if the brief origin issue `#N` is shipped-closed (`state_reason=completed` or equivalent) AND `origin/<deliveryBranch>` has no `xbrief/completed/*` (or legacy `vbrief/completed/*`) whose origin cites `#N`, refuse non-zero. Print one remediation line naming leftover-complete / `scope:complete --merge-commit … --pr …` or `swarm:finalize-cohort`. Do not invent approve/skip phrases. True abandon/supersede still works when the origin is open or not shipped-closed.

2. **Tip-twin predicate = completed-only for this ship path.** The refuse and Tracking/Refs leftover-complete expect a **completed** tip twin, not a cancelled tip twin. `#3476` `verify:completed-tracked` may still treat completed|cancelled as tip-terminal for its own DONE scan; this cancel refuse does not green on cancelled-only land for a shipped Tracking close. Cancelled tip twins remain for true abandon land only.

3. **Compose existing inventory.** Implement the refuse by composing the same issue-state + tip-twin resolvers already used by `completed-tracked-on-delivery` / orphan-active shipped-origin detection. Fail closed when shipped-looking cancel cannot prove tip twin or cannot resolve closed state under those verbs' rules (including `--skip-gh` / cache / reopen races). ⊗ New ad-hoc gh/state path that can disagree with `#3476`.

4. **Always-pin / orphan-active prose recut.** On the shipped-closed Tracking/Refs product-merge path, preamble post-merge lifecycle and orphan-active remediation treat cancel as **abandon-only**, not an alternate ship exit beside complete. Grok through-merge closer stays on `scope:complete` + leftover-complete / `verify:completed-tracked`. Keep cancel available for true abandon when origin is open or not shipped-closed.

5. **DONE probe (B) — first-ship MUST.** On the Tracking/Refs parent-retained closer path after product merge closeout, before parent `DONE`, run existing `verify:completed-tracked -- --issue N` against `origin/<deliveryBranch>`. Exit 1 = not DONE. Reuse `evaluateCompletedTracked` / delivery-tip resolvers (same inventory as item 3). ⊗ Parallel DONE gh probe. Not a new mechanism — habit enforcement made mandatory for this closer path.

6. **Tests.** Unit/integration: cancel on shipped closed-origin brief without completed twin → non-zero + remediation naming leftover-complete. Cancel still works for true supersede/abandon when issue is open or not shipped-closed. Tracking merge fixture: `verify:completed-tracked --issue N` exit 1 until completed twin exists; exit 0 after leftover-complete.

7. **Non-goals.** Do not auto-attest acceptance from GitHub merge alone (#3240). Do not teach cancel to mint completed/. Do not broad-reconcile rewrite. Do not collapse #3476 tip-terminal set globally to completed-only outside this ship-path refuse.

HEAD at dispatch equals `0a2f7b4f94999d154b6e013eefd1a055dfe2102e` (`git rev-parse HEAD`). Pin reads via `git show` at that SHA. In-ceiling thread: current-state `5881429082`, Stop 1 write-back `5881429817`.

## Refutation-target survival

The refutation target does **not** survive.

Dest-local `scope:cancel` after a Tracking/Refs product merge close, when `origin/<deliveryBranch>` has no `xbrief/completed/*` citing `#N`, is not an acceptable ship discharge. At this SHA, cancel clears the active brief without the `#3240` / `#3550` complete gates, while `verify:completed-tracked -- --issue N` still requires a tip twin under `xbrief/completed/` or `xbrief/cancelled/`. Grok through-merge (`#4529` / `#4821`) names parent-retained closer plus post-merge `scope:complete`, with `swarm:finalize-cohort` as leftover land. Cancel is classified as reversible abandon (`REVERSIBLE_ACTIONS`), not a ship terminal (`TERMINAL_ACTIONS` = complete|fail).

## Cancel has no shipped-origin refuse today
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `git show 0a2f7b4f94999d154b6e013eefd1a055dfe2102e:packages/core/src/scope/transition.ts` — `act === "complete"` runs `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` / acceptance walk; `act === "cancel"` only `stampLifecycleWrite(..., "cancel")` then moves to `cancelled/`. `git show 0a2f7b4f94999d154b6e013eefd1a055dfe2102e:packages/core/src/scope/constants.ts` — cancel allowed from any lifecycle folder; cancel ∈ `REVERSIBLE_ACTIONS`; `TERMINAL_ACTIONS` = `{complete, fail}`. No `state_reason` / closed-origin conjunct on the cancel path.
Failure mode: when `scope:complete` refuses on acceptance / `#3550` narrative floor, cancel still succeeds and clears orphan-active locally, so the closer can treat cancel + issue close as DONE while tip has no completed record for `#N`.
Disposition: Bound refuse (proposed A) belongs on the cancel transition / CLI before the move, keyed to shipped-closed origin plus missing tip twin; keep true abandon/supersede when the origin is open or not shipped-closed.

## Tip twin set is completed|cancelled; proposed A names completed only
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `git show 0a2f7b4f94999d154b6e013eefd1a055dfe2102e:packages/core/src/lifecycle/completed-tracked-on-delivery.ts` — `TIP_TERMINAL_FOLDERS = ["completed","cancelled"]`; refusal text requires tracked `completed/` or `cancelled/` on the delivery tip. Related `#4714` AC at live REST also admits completed or cancelled on a fresh clone. `git show 0a2f7b4f94999d154b6e013eefd1a055dfe2102e:packages/core/src/swarm/finalize-cohort.ts` — `listLandedCompletedRelpaths` / `completedBriefRelpathForIssue` scan only `xbrief|vbrief/completed` for origin-close / leftover-complete DONE.
Failure mode: if Bound A refuses cancel only when `completed/*` is missing, a later land of dest `cancelled/` can green `#3476` while still missing the completed record Tracking leftover-complete and finalize origin-close expect. If Bound A is meant to forbid cancelled tip twins for this ship path, that is stricter than `#3476` / `#4714` and must be stated.
Disposition: Before bind, name the tip-twin predicate for the refuse: completed-only (stricter, matches finalize origin-close) versus completed|cancelled (matches `#3476`). Tie the Tracking/Refs product-merge ship path to leftover-complete → completed land, and keep cancelled tip twins for true abandon land only.

## Always-pin prose still offers cancel as post-merge exit
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `git show 0a2f7b4f94999d154b6e013eefd1a055dfe2102e:content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md` post-merge lifecycle card — orchestrator MUST run `scope:complete` or `scope:cancel` after merge. `git show 0a2f7b4f94999d154b6e013eefd1a055dfe2102e:packages/core/src/orphan-active/evaluate.ts` remediation still prints `task scope:cancel … # when abandoning` beside complete for shipped orphans. Contrasted with `git show 0a2f7b4f94999d154b6e013eefd1a055dfe2102e:content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/SKILL.md` Grok through-merge — parent-retained closer plus post-merge `scope:complete`; finalize-cohort is leftover after merge.
Failure mode: a cancel refuse alone can be green in code while always-pin prose still teaches cancel as a legal ship exit after Tracking merge, recreating the observed closer substitution when complete hits the acceptance floor.
Disposition: Bound remedy must recut the shipped-closed Tracking/Refs path in preamble / orphan-active remediation so cancel is abandon-only there; keep Grok closer on `scope:complete` + leftover-complete / `verify:completed-tracked`.

## Swarm / authority lens on the refuse
sharpens-framing
Evidence: Proposed A consults GitHub closed state for origin `#N` and tip blobs on `origin/<deliveryBranch>` — shared lifecycle authority across dest worktree and delivery tip. Existing resolvers already live in `completed-tracked-on-delivery.ts` (`defaultResolveIssueState`, tip blob scan) and orphan-active shipped-origin detection.
Failure mode: a new ad-hoc gh/state path on cancel can disagree with `#3476` under cache / `--skip-gh` / reopen races, so cancel refuses or allows inconsistently with the DONE probe.
Disposition: Compose the refuse from the existing issue-state + tip-twin inventory; fail closed when shipped-looking cancel cannot prove tip twin or cannot resolve closed state under the same rules those verbs already use.

## Optional DONE probe is already named
footnote
Evidence: preamble `#3476` already requires `verify:completed-tracked -- --issue N` exit 0 on `origin/<deliveryBranch>` after `scope:complete` before DONE; CLI + evaluator exist at `packages/cli/src/verify-completed-tracked.ts` and `packages/core/src/lifecycle/completed-tracked-on-delivery.ts`.
Failure mode: none for bind shape — B is habit enforcement of an existing verb, not a new mechanism.
Disposition: Prefer A as the verb choke-point; treat B as checklist reuse, not a second invention.

## Inventory note on cancel stamp pairing
footnote
Evidence: `completed-write-guard.ts` header and cancel-stamp pairing — `cancelled/` destinations pair when they carry a `lifecycleWrite` cancel stamp; closed-origin park to `proposed/` is refused.
Failure mode: none for this refutation; shows cancel is already a stamped abandon path, not a silent delete.
Disposition: No change required for this census; A should keep stamped cancel for true abandon.

## Summary

Grok through-merge (`stop-at: pr-open` + parent-retained closer) squash-merges a Tracking PR, closes the GitHub issue, then runs `scope:cancel` on the dest-local active xBRIEF. Master stays clean of orphans, but no brief lands in `xbrief/completed/`. That is not leftover-complete.

Observed 2026-09-28 on cohort #5105 / #3791 / #4533 / #4659 / #4664 / #4574 / #5110 / #5111 / #4671: product PRs merged, issues closed completed, briefs only in worktree `cancelled/`. Related symptom class: #4714. Related envelope: #4529 / #4821.

## Why cancel happened

`scope:complete` hit acceptance stamp / #3550 narrative floor. Closer substituted cancel + issue close instead of finishing leftover-complete.

## Desired behavior

After a Tracking/Refs product merge for issue `#N`:

1. Leftover-complete (stamp → `scope:complete` / `swarm:finalize-cohort`) so a completed brief is on `origin/<deliveryBranch>`.
2. `verify:completed-tracked -- --issue N` exit 0 before parent `DONE`.
3. `scope:cancel` is not a valid ship discharge for that path.

## Proposed fix (deterministic, low token, simple)

### A. Fail-closed cancel refuse (primary)

`scope:cancel` refuses when:

- brief origin issue `#N` is closed (`state_reason=completed` or equivalent shipped close), and
- `origin/<deliveryBranch>` has no `xbrief/completed/*` whose origin cites `#N`

Print one remediation line: run leftover-complete / `scope:complete --merge-commit … --pr …` (or `swarm:finalize-cohort`). Do not invent approve/skip phrases.

### B. Tiny DONE probe (secondary, optional same PR)

After Tracking merge closeout, parent must run existing `verify:completed-tracked -- --issue N` against `origin/<deliveryBranch>` before `DONE`. Exit 1 = not DONE. No new LLM judgment.

Prefer A alone if one change: it blocks the wrong exit at the verb. B is the DONE checklist already named in preamble/#3476 and was skipped in practice.

## Non-goals

- Auto-attesting acceptance from GitHub merge alone (#3240).
- Teaching cancel to mint completed/.
- Broad reconcile rewrites.

## Acceptance

- Unit/integration: cancel on a shipped closed-origin brief without completed twin → non-zero + remediation naming leftover-complete.
- Cancel still works for true supersede/abandon when issue is open or not shipped-closed.
- Optional: after Tracking merge fixture, `verify:completed-tracked --issue N` exit 1 until completed twin exists; exit 0 after leftover-complete.

## Related

- #4714 (records: completed/ missing on fresh clone)
- #4529 / #4821 (Grok through-merge envelope)
- #3476 (`verify:completed-tracked`)
- #3240 (scope:complete acceptance gate)
